title: carex interior f. keweenawensis
intro: Carex interior f. keweenawensis, commonly known as Keweenaw sedge, is a type of plant species in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Keweenaw sedge is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The plant's bioactive constituents and traditional uses have been studied for their potential health benefits and therapeutic applications, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy in treating various health conditions.
